subject: [RFC PATCH v3 03/14] mm/memory-tiers: Introduce a mapping from nid to tier_slot

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new data structure called 'tier_slot' which is a dense index that maps node IDs (nid) to tiers, allowing for efficient and fixed mapping of nodes to tiers even when tiers come online or offline at runtime. The patch also adds helper functions to retrieve the nodemask associated with a tier slot. This change enables proper accounting of memory in each tier starting from boot time, addressing issues related to DAX memory hotplugging/hot-unplugging.
